name: io.github.ultra-solo/ultra-template
title: ultra-template tasks
description: List, create and move tasks through todo, in progress and done.

environmentVariables.name: TASK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the task API is: an absolute http or https URL.

environmentVariables.name: TASK_API_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long one call to the task API may take, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: How the server speaks: stdio, the default, or http.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port the http transport listens on; 0 lets the operating system assign one.
